title: Figure 7: LOCAAS Turbojet Engine (courtesy of AFRL, Eglin AFB, FL)
description: Color photograph of a gray LOCAAS (Low Cost Autonomous Attack System) munition airframe with deployed wings and tail fins, with cutaway panels exposing the internal turbojet engine and components, against a white background. The caption reads "Figure 7. LOCAAS Turbojet Engine (courtesy of AFRL, Eglin AFB, FL)." The text below lists military uses for a positron-fueled UAV.
